name: Haar Wavelet Transform
aliases: Haar Wavelet Transformation for Multi-resolution Volumetric Data
definition: A wavelet-based algorithm used to generate multi-resolution (MR) data models by applying low-pass and high-pass filters to discrete data, yielding summary and detail information.
summary: The Haar Wavelet Transform generates multi-resolution volumetric data using the simplest step-function wavelet, making it computationally trivial but less smooth than other wavelet methods.
